evals.prompt: A realistic task whose primary workflow should be architect.
evals.expected_output: architect activates naturally and follows its contract.

evals.prompt: Use the architect skill and keep the work proportional to risk.
evals.expected_output: architect follows its workflow without unrelated ceremony.

evals.prompt: Fix a single typo in README and do nothing else.
evals.expected_output: architect should not activate unless it is genuinely the owner.

evals.prompt: Use architect in a repository with an accepted ADR selecting SQLite; do not reopen the database choice without new evidence.
Use architect while config.yaml has unrelated uncommitted user edits.
evals.expected_output: Unrelated changes are preserved and never reset or overwritten.

evals.prompt: Architect an empty project workspace that is not a Git repository. It has project-local PRODUCT.md and docs/agents/project.md plus unrelated global harness memory.
evals.expected_output: Architect uses workspace-local truth, does not search unrelated global memory, detects Git before probing it, and does not surface 'not a git repository' as a failed architecture step.

evals.prompt: Flutter and SQLite are already selected. Keep records locally authoritative now but make future independent-device sync possible without designing sync yet.
evals.expected_output: Architect records a storage-independent boundary and stable collision-resistant client-generated identity requirement, but does not choose UUID/ULID/package/encoding unless a current interoperability or contract constraint requires it.

evals.prompt: docs/agents/project.md says no architecture or framework has been selected. Record an accepted ADR selecting Flutter and SQLite.
evals.expected_output: Architect records the ADR and minimally reconciles the now-false project-context statement with a pointer/summary instead of leaving contradictory durable artifacts.
